title: Viewer
body: Load any ledgdex ledger, and verify each signature and hash in your browser. Keep your own ledger here too. Sign messages to sellers, collect their receipts, and download your ledger as a complete dex. The viewer uploads nothing. Your key stays in this browser, and the viewer stores it only sealed with your passphrase.
Your key: none
Keep it here:
